notes: Budgets set by the Technical Director. Re-baselined to measurement after M3 stage 2 (2026-09-29) and again after stage 3 (2026-09-30, 3,000- and 20,000-pass long runs, build/stage3-long/). Units: raster cycles in this spike, DMA included, which is what the runner measures and what adds up to the 19,656-cycle frame (engine/README.md#budget-units). Main-loop routines and zone IRQs get ~5% over the 20,000-pass max, rounded up to 50: the spike's full joint motion cycle is ~88,800 frames (LCM of D's 800, amp's 96 and the X bounces up to 592), so 20,000 is ~22% of it, but the structural worst cases (sort reversal, flicker at minimum D) recur every 800-frame D cycle (25 times in the run), and the maxima moved 0-6% from 3,000 to 20,000 passes. Exact locks only for constant DMA-free paths; mux_irq_top is NOT DMA-free in stage 3 (ghost sprites, see its check), so it has an interim derived limit until the engine fix. The short make test windows won't reach these maxima; the limits must hold in any window. 'stage' is the build stage the engine has reached (docs/milestones/M3-engine-basics.md, rule 1): checks with a higher 'from_stage' print PENDING and fail only under --strict (M3 sign-off). The raster-engineer bumps 'stage' at the start of each stage. Main-loop routines use profile_excl_irq so zone IRQs inside them don't count.

checks.name: mux_irq_top (swap + slots 0-7)
checks.source: INTERIM, derived 2026-09-30; re-lock at 387 when the ghost-sprite fix lands. Two constant paths: 378 (> 8 slots, re-arms) and 387 (<= 8 slots, IrqDone: 378 - 55 + 1 + 63, counted from the locked irq_rearm 41 and irq_exit 60, and measured). Re-baselined by the Technical Director 2026-09-30 after M3 stage 3 (fast path + fair flicker, pinning off), from long runs on the stage 3 overloaded spike: 3,000 and 20,000 consecutive passes in one trace (build/stage3-long/longrun.py, the runner's own profile_costs / irq_time_by_frame; command: uv run --package budget-runner python build/stage3-long/longrun.py 20000 1000): 378 x2,953, 387 x43 and 398/399/411/417/421 once each in 3,001 (the same five in 20,001). Probe (build/stage3-long/irqtop2.py): every one of the five outliers, and none of 2,995 others, starts with enabled hardware sprites left at Y 53-55. The VIC compares sprite Y with the low 8 bits of the raster, so on PAL (312 lines) a sprite at Y <= 55 re-triggers on line 256 + Y and displays across the wrap into lines 16-20, inside this IRQ (4 sprites 4-7: 11 cycles a line x 4 lines = 44, measured 43). It happens when a frame has < 16 slots, so hardware sprites keep their top-slot Y. Worst case: 8 such sprites, 5 lines x 19 cycles (docs/reference/vic-ii-timing.md#sprite-dma) = 95 over 387 -> 482. Was 378 (lock, stage 2)

checks.name: mux_irq_zone (one IRQ, up to 16 slots)
checks.source: Re-baselined by the Technical Director 2026-09-30 after M3 stage 3 (fast path + fair flicker, pinning off), from long runs on the stage 3 overloaded spike: 3,000 and 20,000 consecutive passes in one trace (build/stage3-long/longrun.py, the runner's own profile_costs / irq_time_by_frame; command: uv run --package budget-runner python build/stage3-long/longrun.py 20000 1000): 154 / 799 / 2,690 over 5,659 zone IRQs (3,000 frames) and 154 / 804 / 2,693 over 37,774 (20,000). 7 of 37,774 are over 1,600 (next worst 1,530). Probe (build/stage3-long/zone2690.py, 2026-09-30): the 2,690 IRQ writes 14 slots (40-53) from line 205 to 248, Ys 3 lines apart, so each next slot frees within the 2-line wait threshold and the IRQ waits instead of re-arming; margins 2-4 lines, mux_late_count 0. Designed behaviour; ceiling ~16 slots x 3 lines = ~3,000 + DMA. A long zone IRQ delays nothing (no fixed entry in the zone region), so this is a regression watch. 2,693 + ~5% -> 2,850 (was 1,600, stage 2)

checks.name: free CPU per frame (game promise)
checks.source: engine/README.md#frame-budget: games are promised >= 7,200 cycles a frame for their own logic. In the spike that is spike_move + idle; spike_move is >= 1,907 raster (measured, stage 2), so idle >= 5,300 keeps the promise in every frame, sort stress and flicker included. Measured 5,888 (stage 2); stage 3 overloaded spike 5,824 after 6,000 frames and 5,808 (363 x 16) after 21,000 (2026-09-30 long runs). Idle-loop iterations are 16 cycles (counted) and exclude DMA, so this is conservative
